content:
Today marks an unforgettable milestone for both HorrorFuel.com and me. In a groundbreaking first for our site, I had the unique privilege of sitting down for a conversation with professional psychic medium Angel Morgan. Having never interviewed a psychic medium before, I wasn’t sure what to expect. However, the experience turned out to be a mind-bending thrill.

Angel specializes in intuitive readings for both humans and animals. This made the session especially exciting given my own bustling household of two dogs, four cats, and a flourishing number of fish.

An Uncanny and Jaw-Dropping Encounter

Before diving into the video, a little context makes this session all the more astounding. A few months ago, my personal Facebook account was completely deleted (long story). This forced me to start a brand-new page from scratch. As a result, the intimate details Angel brought to light during our reading don’t exist anywhere online. And we had never spoken before our interview. While I have maintained a lifelong openness to the supernatural, even sharing a personal story in the video about how a spirit once saved my life, the sheer accuracy of Angel’s insights left my jaw on the floor.

Over Three Decades of Bridging Realms

Angel Morgan brings over 30 years of professional experience in the paranormal and supernatural realms to her craft. While her pet mediumship frequently extends to exotic animals, her ability to connect with my own pets and pinpoint specific, unrecorded details was nothing short of extraordinary. For readers interested in scheduling a personal reading, you can reach Angel directly through her website at RaisingEnergy.com. And I highly recommend it.

Finding Peace in the Unknown

Walking away from our conversation, my mind was completely blown. But more than that, I felt a profound sense of peace and relief, which I have needed for a long time. It was a powerful, comforting reminder of the mysteries that lie just beyond our everyday vision. Watch the full video below to see the reading unfold.

I highly recommend booking a session with Angel to experience her remarkable gift firsthand. Besides her website, you can also find Angel Morgan on Instagram. She also has two podcasts. One, titled The Reel Wicked Film Talk, is a new review podcast that takes a unique approach to film. She explores the magic and supernatural aspects of films, not the directing or acting. The other is the Creature Code Podcast. Subscribe to her podcasts now.
